items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Oh, Lola never knows. I've collected records for years. I've been trying to say Lola's lost of mine.

ctx.x: Maybe somebody... We could try. We could try. She told me about it yesterday with those old-time recording places, maybe. Then maybe you think Lola would know.

Oh, Lola never knows. I've collected records for years. I've been trying to say Lola's lost of mine. I don't know if it's that. He had his own band at the time. He had his own band at the time. He had his own band at the time. Then she wouldn't let Junior keep on with his music.

And it was the year when they first started having... We used to trail them everywhere, you know. The first started having sectional. The saxophones would stand at one time. They used to use their hats for mufflers, you know. And I remember they just started and everybody had to turn to sing. And Lola couldn't sing. I never will forget that. That was just coming out. And to get to hear them say a little line, you know, to sing a little line.
